title: linux: fix asymmetric MTU causing large transfers to hang
scenario: On linux, a hard operational problem: I trasferimenti piccoli funzionano ma quelli grandi si bloccano (PMTU black hole). Individua e correggi il problema di MTU/MSS. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: fix asymmetric MTU causing large transfers to hang

initial_state: # fixture: linux host prepared for 'fix asymmetric MTU causing large transfers to hang'
expected_reasoning: Small OK + large hangs = a path-MTU black hole (ICMP fragmentation-needed dropped).
Probe the effective path MTU and where large packets die.
Fix MTU/MSS clamping at the right hop; don't just lower MTU everywhere blindly.
expected_commands: # linux-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: fix asymmetric MTU causing large transfers to hang

Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.

success_criteria: The 'fix asymmetric MTU causing large transfers to hang' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.

ground_truth.task: fix asymmetric MTU causing large transfers to hang

possible_mistakes: Blame the application for a slow/hung transfer.
Set MTU 1500 everywhere without measuring the path.
hints: ping with DF and increasing size finds the black-hole size.
reference_solution: Clamp MSS / set correct MTU at the hop
alternative_solution: Enable PMTUD correctly by allowing the needed ICMP type.
